enunciado: Multiply A (2x3) = {{1, 2, 3}, {4, 5, 6}} by B (3x2) = {{7, 8}, {9, 10}, {11, 12}} and show the resulting 2x2 matrix. Also check that multiplying by the identity leaves the matrix unchanged.
pistas: C[i][j] is the dot product of row i of A and column j of B.
You need three loops: i, j and k.
